summary: Direct access to Templar._available_variables is deprecated, removed in ansible-core 2.23; use the public Templar.available_variables attribute.
questions: My plugin reads templar._available_variables and warns, what should I use?

answer_card.title: Use Templar.available_variables
answer_card.answer_md: Replace `templar._available_variables` with **`templar.available_variables`**. The private attribute is removed in ansible-core 2.23.
